ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Welfare Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of funds in the Minnesota welfare system to identify potential vulnerabilities and connections to other entities.
questions: What are the primary sources of funding for Minnesota's welfare system?
How are these funds being allocated and managed?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and allocations within the Minnesota welfare system, we may uncover patterns or anomalies that indicate fraudulent activity or corruption.
